iPhone

Keep your bank. Earn on every dollar. Rivo puts the cash in your bank account to work, generating automatic earnings. No switching, no effort.

Built to keep earning. Rivo works quietly in the background.

Connect your bank securely
Link your checking account in minutes. Rivo analyzes your balance and spending patterns. You just tell it how much cash you want to keep on hand, and it manages the rest on Autopilot.

Earning starts automatically
Once set up, your money goes to work without you lifting a finger. Rivo automatically moves your spare cash in and out as your balance changes. No long-term lockups, so your money is accessible when you need it.

Smart planning around your bills
Rivo is built to help you stay ahead of your upcoming expenses. Rivo aims to keep enough in your bank for daily life. As upcoming bills are detected, Rivo moves money back to your bank account to cover them.

- Every bank lures me initially with higher interest rates and eventually drops them silently. I need to have some money to pay credit cards etc and I get very little interest because of these bad practices from banks. Rivo just solves that problem completely because now I don’t need to worry about moving my money to a higher yield account etc. It’s something I always wanted and now there is something which solves that problem!

















# Amazing app









Every bank lures me initially with higher interest rates and eventually drops them silently. I need to have some money to pay credit cards etc and I get very little interest because of these bad practices from banks. Rivo just solves that problem completely because now I don’t need to worry about moving my money to a higher yield account etc. It’s something I always wanted and now there is something which solves that problem!

- I find it amazing how Rivo’s Autopilot lets you earn extra cash in such an easy way. The extra cash that you should be earning is just sitting idle, but with Rivo that completely changes. I just signed up and I didn’t have to change banks or anything, and from then on I wake up richer. I just want to give a big thanks to the wonderful developers who made this.
